notes.title: A little about the plot and the game as a whole
notes.notes:
Actions in the game are built in such a way that everything happens gradually. The situation is aggravated, insidious enemies arise, the road is blocked by uncommon puzzles. The authors paid much attention to the plot: there are many stories, references, cat-scenes. There is no typical plot: "I woke up in some strange place, I need to get out of here." Everything is much more interesting.

It all started with the fact that the doctor of psychological sciences, who left traditional medicine, decided to prove that the soul exists. Naturally, he did not wish anyone evil and death. According to the scientist, in people who are mentally ill, the soul leaves the body. It is because of this that cardinal changes in their behavior and psyche occur. The bodies of the sick become an empty vessel for demons and other evil spirits.

The doctor himself was the chief doctor in a psychiatric hospital, located near the mansion in Zaklyuche. The situation allowed him to transport a certain number of patients to the well-equipped cellar of his brother's mansion. The basement has remained practically untouched since the times of the USSR, therefore it has become a good place for research, where no one will interfere. A great role was played also by the location of the mansion and its bad reputation. The walls of the building absorbed a lot of pain and suffering, not one person died in it from disease. The curse of the architect closes the gloomy picture, which spent half of his life building a mansion.

Having not received the expected grandiose results, the doctor decides to resort to black magic, which he has long practiced. As a result, a portal was opened between our world - the living, and the world of the dead - devils, demons. As the savior of mankind is our main character - Michael. His wife Maria is the owner of the rather rare and controversial profession "Exorcist". Michael - an office worker who never seriously took the lessons of his wife and constantly joked about her.

One day, Maria went to Zaklyuche by the call of Zhdanov VA, the owner of the mansion. He asked to inspect the sharply ill dock, which became

behave completely inadequate. What will happen next, you can learn from the history of the game. Now the salvation of mankind is in your hands!

notes.notes: If you are a video game maker or a streamer interested in new games, you have over 8,000 YouTube subscribers or 3,000 subscribers on a twitch channel, at least 4 videos per month with 4000 views each. Then we will give you a free copy of the game, for review.
